name: Deploy Blazor App to Azure App Service

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main  # or your deployment branch

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v3
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

    - name: Install WebAssembly build tools
      run: dotnet workload install wasm-tools

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build in Release mode
      run: dotnet build ./Mark4/Mark4.csproj --configuration Release

    - name: Publish the Server project
      run: dotnet publish ./Mark4/Mark4.csproj -c Release -o ./publish

    - name: Deploy to Azure Web App
      uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v2
      with:
        app-name: YOUR_AZURE_APP_NAME           # Replace with your Azure App Service name
        publish-profile: ${{ secrets.AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE }}
        package: ./publish
